sections.title: Bridge to YKI-style four-skill work: meaning and form
body: Goal: Read task instructions strategically and complete an original four-skill mini-clinic under light time pressure.
Core vocabulary: en instruktion, en mottagare, ett syfte. Key phrases: Vem är mottagaren? · Vad måste svaret innehålla? · Jag ger en orsak och föreslår en lösning.

Before producing language, identify four things: situation, recipient, purpose and required details. In comprehension, read or listen for the question first, then locate evidence. In production, complete the communicative task before polishing grammar.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

examples.en: I give a reason and suggest a solution.

sections.title: Register, evidence and independent use
body: Register model: “Jag skulle vilja ändra min bokning.” is a formal-neutral request way to express “I would like to change my booking.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: What two alternatives are offered? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: What has NOT changed? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: You cannot attend an agreed activity. Leave a 45–60 second message: identify yourself, explain why, propose an alternative and ask for confirmation. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write 90–110 words to a community centre about an activity you booked. Explain a problem, give two key details and request a practical solution. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: The recipient becomes a friend rather than the community centre; adapt register while preserving the task details.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
